task:
REVISE THE F4 DESIGN DOC TO ADDRESS NINE CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS (PR #801). Target branch codex/run-38015883683-1, expected head a9b06bb; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md may change. Re-verify every claim you touch against the code (cite file:line) and keep the document's existing structure. Address each finding explicitly; add a short 'Review dispositions (2026-10-10)' subsection at the end listing finding -> what changed.

1. (P2, §5 result card) 'Expose the overall tier before requiring it': in selected-archetype mode `/api/archetypes/rankings` returns only the selected fit's `tier`; `overall_development_potential` has no accompanying best/overall tier. Change the design so the Best Colony Potential headline shows a tier ONLY when the API supplies `best_tier`; add an explicit small API prerequisite ('slice 1b: expose summary best_tier in the rankings and local search payloads') to the API dependency map and the PR plan (F4a may land without it, showing the headline number without a tier; never compute an API-owned tier in the browser).

2. (P2, §5 honest uncertainty) 'Label no-pick confidence as general evidence': in Any mode the `confidence`/`completeness` come from the system's general evidence (local search), not a selected fit. Define mode-specific wording: 'Evidence confidence' (Any) vs 'Fit confidence' (selected archetype) in the badge and the accessible description; forbid the word 'fit' in Any mode.

3. (P1, §4 dependency map / minimum tier) 'Bound the all-system selected-archetype query': do NOT make min_score=0 (tier D) the UI default — at production scale the selected-archetype path sorts and counts ~198.5M candidates with no precomputed index for the cross-table ordering, and `_archetype_rankings_v3` issues an uncapped COUNT(*). Change the design: default minimum tier is B (min_score=60) or the API's own default (40) — pick one and justify from the code; the UI may not send a floor below the API default until a bounded/capped query contract (server-side cap on candidates, index-backed ordering, bounded count) exists; add that contract as an API prerequisite for offering tiers C/D in the picker; cross-reference the summary's `weighted_potential` index used by the Any path.

4. (P1, §2/§3/§8) 'Keep F4 behind the governed production sequence': current main does not supersede the roadmap's production gate — migrations 010/011 are not applied, the published generation has no Finder products, and the selected-archetype endpoint returns 503 in production today. Rewrite the status/goal text so F4a/F4b are explicitly code-only increments validated on fixtures, shipped behind a feature gate (name the mechanism: existing runtime config/feature-flag pattern in apps/web if there is one — cite it; otherwise propose a build-time env flag read through the existing config module) that keeps the picker hidden until the governed sequence has published Finder products; define the 503 'ranking unavailable' state as a first-class UI state; state plainly that this design does not authorize promotion.

5. (P2, §6/§7 normalization) 'Preserve the distance reference during normalization': selected-archetype results are measured from Sol, Any-mode anchored results from the chosen star. Carry a `distance_reference` ({kind: 'anchor'|'sol', id64/name}) through the normalized ExploreSystem and the persisted shortlist/compare shape, and make compare rows label distances by reference (or exclude cross-reference distances from comparison). Update the F4a/F4c file lists accordingly.

6. (P2, same area) 'Preserve archetype identity when normalizing scores': a selected-archetype `score` must not be persisted as the generic `archetype_score`/'Development score'. Carry `score_kind` ('overall_potential' | 'selected_fit') and `selected_archetype` through ExploreSystem and persisted pins/comparisons; make compare mode-aware (compare only like with like) or persist the overall potential alongside. Update F4a/F4c scope.

7. (P2, §4/§5/§6) 'Expose truncation for selected rankings': `/api/archetypes/rankings` is paginated (default 50 rows, `offset`, returns `total`/`count`). Carry pagination metadata through the facade; define a visible 'Showing N of TOTAL' state and either a 'Load more'/offset navigation or an explicit truncation notice; add URL state for offset; keep result counts and truncation synchronized per the spatial product contract.

8. (P2, §5 keyboard/focus) 'Gate result autofocus on a new anchor': ExploreWorkspace.svelte ~389-399 keys autofocus on `${anchor.id64}:${results.dataUpdatedAt}`, so every rerank would steal focus from the picker. Specify that F4b changes the autofocus key to an explicit anchor-selection revision (and Any mode) instead of result freshness, and add it to F4b's file list/tests.

9. (P2, §5 map hand-off / §8) 'Retain the selected system when replacing result points': when a rerank omits the previously selected system, the workspace replaces `systems`, the Finder contribution emits only the new points, and the Babylon adapter drops the selected marker. Specify that the selected system is kept as a separate contribution (or its point is guaranteed) before the result contribution is replaced; add to F4b scope and tests.

Also update section 9's owner questions if any become moot or new ones arise (e.g. default minimum tier B vs API default 40; feature-gate mechanism). Validation: `git diff --name-only origin/main` lists only the design doc; Markdown renders. Commit message: 'docs(finder): F4 design — address review findings (gate, bounded query, tiers, identity, pagination, focus, selection)'.
